title: What Edith Saw
pitch: A boat Victor paid for came in early and left empty. Edith keeps the watch hut. She saw who met it, and she's terrified.

clue_a.label: Container forty
lines: Container forty, seal broken, empty. The floor's still wet with seawater. That cargo came off a boat tonight.

clue_b.label: The bollard
lines: A mooring rope on the bollard, cut clean and still wet. A boat tied up here tonight and left in a hurry.
